hints.title: Dimensional Independence
hints.text: Horizontal and vertical cuts operate on mutually independent coordinate axes.

hints.title: Interval Projection
hints.text: Project rectangles onto 1D intervals along the x-axis and y-axis independently.

hints.title: Interval Merging
hints.text: Sort intervals by start coordinate and count gaps where running maximum end is reached.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorts x and y 1D projections and merges intervals in single sweeps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating geometric cut lines across 2D plane incurs quadratic overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m) auxiliary space stores projected 1D intervals.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decomposes 2D cutting problem into independent 1D interval separation checks.
